text:
emma: Quick heads up 1: we're scheduling an ABI bump + quant matmul v3 roll tonight. quiet window 23:30-02:30 UTC. need minimal canary plan, pin ttl, rollback criteria, and a one-liner for release notes.

deploy-bot: Preflight: ci artifacts built, signatures OK, perf-smoke queued. Use `deploy-bot set-slice` to start.
juan: i'll run a tiny canary (0.25%) in eu-west first. warmstart 8m, observe 20m. If p99 > +18% or error-rate >0.25% -> immediate pin/rollback.
ops-lee: Quiet window ACK. prefer pin TTL 8h for post-incident forensics. We'll drain eu-west then us-central. avoid infra churn during window.
patrick: Note: matmul v3 reduces median on 512-2048 seq but shows occasional p99 regressions on >4096 locally. include a long-seq traffic slice in canary at ~0.05% if possible.
li: Release note suggestion: "Runtime: ABI bump and curated quant matmul kernels (v3). Improves median throughput for mid-length sequences; canary staged with automatic fallback." Keep it short.
emma: rollback rules proposal: (A) p99 +15% vs baseline sustained 15m; (B) error-rate delta +0.2% sustained 10m; (C) >0.05% hosts reporting OOMs in 10m. Any trigger -> pin v3 and shift traffic to v2.
juan: Canary command:
```
# eu-west tiny canary -> include long-seq slice
deploy-bot set-slice --service engine --from v2 --to v3 --slice 0.0025 --warmstart 8m --meta "longseq=0.0005" 
```
deploy-bot: Action queued: `pin engine:quant-matmul:v3 --ttl=8h --reason="night-canary+abi"`.
ops-lee: We'll run drains at 23:35-23:45 (eu-west) and 00:10-00:25 (us-central). oncall will be paged if alerts fire.
li: i'll open a tiny docs PR with the one-liner and note the binary +7MB size change.
emma: i'll hit the canary at 6525001800 unless objections. please post rollback votes here if alarms trigger.
patrick: +1 from me. watching dashboards.
juan: If we need to rollback quickly:
```
# full rollback
deploy-bot set-slice --service engine --from v3 --to v2 --slice 1.0 --force
deploy-bot unpin engine:quant-matmul:v3
```

deploy-bot: `pin engine:quant-matmul:v3 --ttl=8h --reason="night-canary+abi"` applied by @emma at 6525001800.
emma: Canary start posted. i'll update every 15m: p95/p99, kv-cache hit, mem-delta. Thanks all. :rocket:
